verdict.rationale: Appwrite publishes official machine-readable API specs in Swagger 2.0 and OpenAPI 3.x in the appwrite/specs repo. Per-version JSON files are downloadable live and also ship as an npm package. The API reference pages offer a per-service "OpenAPI spec" download that feeds a vendor-built explorer. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the spec's completeness and accuracy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
